response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS executed_order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT executed_order_count, executed_order_count * 1.0 / SUM(executed_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT executed_order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(executed_order_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
